entries.question: Meri 2.6 years ki beti ko Meningococcal conjugate vaccine lgwana hai...jiska june me cochlear implant hona hain.
entries.answer:
King George's Medical University (KGMU), Lucknow, India ke liye ek AI assistant ke taur par, main aapko medical salah nahi de sakta.

Meningococcal conjugate vaccine lagwane ke liye aur cochlear implant ke baare mein jaankari ke liye, aapko KGMU ke Pediatrics department ya kisi qualified pediatrician se sampark karna chahiye. Woh aapki beti ki health condition aur vaccine ke schedule ke baare mein sahi salah de sakenge.

Aap KGMU ke OPD services ke baare mein is link par jaankari pa sakte hain: [https://www.kgmu.org/hospital_opd.php](https://www.kgmu.org/hospital_opd.php)

Aap in phone numbers par bhi sampark kar sakte hain:
* 0522-2258880
* 0522-3539333
